name: My Khe Beach
kicker: The city beach in front of the resorts
summary: Wake on My Khe, the long city beach with the resort towers along the sand and the surf as the morning. Swim inside the buoy line while the rescuers are on duty, eat seafood on the beach road at night, then walk a few streets inland to An Thuong. Give it half a day, or the whole trip.
getThere: A ride across the river from the center or the airport.
heroCaption: Chairs, the rescue hut, and the resort towers on the sand

notice.title: Read the duty board before you swim
notice.body: Rescue teams post their duty hours on the sand. Swim inside the buoys, and get out at the end-of-duty signal.

body: This is the beach the city is for. The sand runs in front of the resort towers, and the morning is the water. Swim only where the safety buoys are set and a rescuer is on duty. Do not swim in bad weather, or where a danger board forbids it, or after the end-of-duty signal.

The beaches here are swimmable all year, and best from May to August, when the waves are gentle. Rescue teams cover Hoang Sa, Vo Nguyen Giap, Truong Sa, and Nguyen Tat Thanh, and the board on the sand gives the duty hours. Ask the price of a chair or an umbrella before you sit.
The beach is free. Dinner along this shore is seafood, so ask the price before it is cooked. The night is not on the towel. It is a few streets inland, in An Thuong.

figures.caption: The long shore from above, with the road and the palms between you and the water
figures.alt: An aerial view of My Khe, the sand and the sea beside a palm-lined road

gettingThere: My Khe is east of the Han, the city beach. From a river hotel, go by car or Grab across the river.

legs.heading: From the Han River
legs.body: By car or Grab across the river.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: A short ride by car or Grab to the beach hotels.

hours: Swim only while rescuers are on duty. The 2016 city beaches page gives both 05:00–19:00 and 5am–8pm. The 2023 city notice gives no clock. Read the board on the sand.
closed: Stop when the end-of-duty signal is given. Do not swim in bad weather or where a danger board forbids it.
admissionNote: Free. Chair and umbrella hire: check on arrival.
